This is for you

Happy birthday, my jinehh! I hope today reminds you of how loved and special you are, not just today, but every single day. I’m so grateful that I get to celebrate another year of your life right by your side. I know you've got some personal things weighing on your mind lately, and I just want to remind you that you don't have to carry everything all by yourself—I'm right here with you.

I hope this year brings you so many good things, gets you closer to your dreams, and that everything you're working for falls into place. Don't rush yourself, okay? you don't need everything figured out right away. Take your time, enjoy life, and trust yourself.

Whatever path you choose, I'll always be here cheering you on. Just remember that I've always got your back, no matter what. Happy birthday, Jinehh.

Happy birthday, khesia.
